metadata.description: TCM monitoring template aligned with CISA Secure Cloud Business Applications (SCuBA) baseline for Microsoft Entra ID. Covers conditional access, authentication methods, authorization, cross-tenant access, and named locations.
metadata.license: Portions adapted from CISA SCuBA SCBs (TLP:CLEAR). See URL for full license terms.

controls.title: Legacy authentication SHALL be blocked
controls.guidance: A Conditional Access policy SHALL be configured to block legacy authentication (Exchange ActiveSync + Other clients) for all users. Drift on this CA policy means legacy auth may be re-enabled.

controls.title: Users detected as high risk SHALL be blocked
controls.guidance: A Conditional Access policy SHALL block users categorized as high risk by Identity Protection. Requires Entra ID P2.

controls.title: Sign-ins detected as high risk SHALL be blocked
controls.guidance: A Conditional Access policy SHALL block sign-ins determined high risk by Identity Protection. Requires Entra ID P2.

controls.title: Phishing-resistant MFA SHALL be enforced for all users
controls.guidance: A Conditional Access policy SHALL require phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2, Windows Hello, Entra CBA, device-bound passkeys) for all users on all resources.

controls.title: Alternative MFA SHALL be enforced if phishing-resistant MFA not yet deployed
controls.guidance: If phishing-resistant MFA is not enforced yet, a Conditional Access policy SHALL require MFA for all users. This is a stopgap measure.

controls.title: Microsoft Authenticator SHALL show login context information
controls.guidance: If Microsoft Authenticator is enabled, it SHALL display application name and geographic location in push/passwordless notifications. Monitor the AuthenticationMethodPolicy for changes to these settings.

controls.title: Authentication Methods migration SHALL be set to Migration Complete
controls.guidance: The Manage Migration feature SHALL be set to Migration Complete to disable the legacy MFA/SSPR screen. TCM monitors the PolicyMigrationState property.

controls.title: SMS, Voice Call, and Email OTP SHALL be disabled
controls.guidance: The authentication methods SMS, Voice Call, and Email One-Time Passcode (OTP) SHALL be disabled. These are the weakest authenticators. Monitor the AuthenticationMethodPolicy for re-enablement.

controls.title: Phishing-resistant MFA SHALL be required for highly privileged roles
controls.guidance: A dedicated Conditional Access policy SHALL enforce phishing-resistant MFA for Global Admin, Privileged Role Admin, User Admin, SharePoint Admin, Exchange Admin, Hybrid Identity Admin, Application Admin, and Cloud Application Admin.

controls.title: Managed devices SHOULD be required for authentication
controls.guidance: A Conditional Access policy SHOULD require that devices be Microsoft Entra hybrid joined or Intune compliant. Requires Microsoft Intune.

controls.title: Managed devices SHOULD be required to register MFA
controls.guidance: A Conditional Access policy SHOULD require a managed device when registering security information. Prevents adversaries from registering their own MFA device.

controls.title: Device code authentication SHOULD be blocked
controls.guidance: A Conditional Access policy SHOULD block device code authentication flow to prevent device code phishing attacks.

controls.title: Only administrators SHALL be allowed to register applications
controls.guidance: In User Settings, 'Users can register applications' SHALL be set to No. Monitor the AuthorizationPolicy for changes.

controls.title: Only administrators SHALL be allowed to consent to applications
controls.guidance: Under Consent and permissions, 'User consent for applications' SHALL be set to 'Do not allow user consent'. Monitor the AuthorizationPolicy for changes.

controls.title: An admin consent workflow SHALL be configured
controls.guidance: Users SHALL be able to request admin consent. Admin consent workflow SHALL be configured with designated reviewers.

controls.title: Guest users SHOULD have limited access to directory objects
controls.guidance: Guest user access should be set to 'Limited access' or 'Most restrictive'. Monitor the AuthorizationPolicy GuestUserRoleId property for changes.

controls.title: Only users with Guest Inviter role SHOULD be able to invite guests
controls.guidance: Under External collaboration settings, Guest invite settings should be 'Only users assigned to specific admin roles can invite guest users'.

controls.title: Guest invites SHOULD only be allowed to specific authorized domains
controls.guidance: Collaboration restrictions should allow invitations only to specified domains. Monitor cross-tenant access policy for unauthorized domain additions.
